name: smwmusic-sudsy-soda-lake
title: Sudsy Soda Lake
description:
The other winning entry from 72hoSPC #13! Per the contest theme, I opted to make an overworld theme for that little section of overworld that contains the Soda Lake level. I tried to imagine a bubbly sort of beach tune, given that soda is fizzy.

Fitting for upbeat beach overworlds.
